title: Aida, Oman — Trump International Luxury Golf Resort and Residences
raw_content:
Aida Muscat, Sultanate of Oman

Perched 100 meters above the sea, AIDA is an iconic cliffside mixed-use master development overlooking the Gulf of Oman in Muscat.

Spread across 3.5 million square meters of pristine coastal topography, AIDA is designed as an urban escape combining luxury second homes, premium residences, oceanfront villas, and world-class hospitality.

Key Project Highlights:

  • Partnership with Trump International to develop the Trump International Golf Club Oman, featuring a championship 18-hole golf course.
  • Luxury 5-star Trump Hotel, private members clubhouse, wellness centers, and cliffside infinity pools.
  • Property Types: 3 to 7-bedroom cliffside mansions, ocean-facing villas, and premium branded residences.
  • Freehold ownership for all nationalities with residency/golden visa eligibility under Omani real estate regulations.
